mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drag on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST declines > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) are both rising simultaneously, it signals a toxic combination of labor market weakness and monetary tightening that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and FEDFUNDS both rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a favorable combination of strong manufacturing activity and accommodative monetary policy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing above 3% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a healthy combination of strong economic growth and a tight labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
